UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -e; cd \"{{$FullRootDir}}\"; SHA=$(curl -fsSL \"https://api.github.com/repos/kkolk/AMPTemplates/commits/main\" | grep -m1 '\"sha\"' | cut -d'\"' -f4); [ -n \"$SHA\" ] || { echo \"could not resolve commit sha\" >&2; exit 1; }; echo \"fetching scripts at commit $SHA\"; curl -fL --retry 3 -o run.sh \"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkolk/AMPTemplates/$SHA/cirunnerrun.sh\"; curl -fL --retry 3 -o install.sh \"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kkolk/AMPTemplates/$SHA/cirunnerinstall.sh\"; chmod +x run.sh install.sh; grep -m1 LAUNCHER_REV run.sh"
